scenario: Conversation between two individuals in a romantic relationship
learner_goal: Ask the other to go to dinner with you (<extra_info>Extra information: you want to have a romantic dinner at a fancy restaurant</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Liam Johnson
transcript.content: Noah, can I ask you something? Would you like to go to dinner with me this Saturday evening—I found a lovely restaurant downtown I’d love to take you to, something a bit more special than our usual morning chats.

transcript.content: I’d love to, Liam — that sounds lovely. What time were you thinking and what kind of food is it?
